title: Granite vs Gemini head-to-head (additive dual-provider note)
baseline: LightGBM/TF-IDF ranking scores_2026 (audited; not modified by this comparison)

strengths: Fixed 768-d multilingual embedding space for retrieval/similarity
Grounded ranking-signal narratives (no invented patch URLs)

gemini.role: executive synthesis + triage playbooks from Granite technical rationales
strengths: Structured JSON playbooks (summary, mitigation, patch guidance)
Zero measured patch-URL hallucination on smoke suite
Priority tiers preserved from upstream ML ranking

head_to_head.ranking_consistency: Both providers consume ML priority tiers; neither re-ranks the audited top500/scores.

token_economics.note: Granite Lite embedding tokens are metered on watsonx; Gemini smoke suite size is small (5) with null avg latency in report.

latency.granite: batch embedding; instruct narratives offline/template on Lite when instruct ID unavailable

explanation_style.gemini: Executive brief + containment/remediation/verification playbook grounded in Granite text

head_to_head.coverage_note: Gemini executive records are linked 1:1 to Granite explanation CVEs via scripts/build_gemini_from_granite.py.
